purpose: Review a finite issuer-owned productive-asset, capital-expenditure, construction-in-progress, utilization and maintenance lifecycle domain before opening source rows, filing text, asset or project values, candidate values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.environmental_boundary: Campaign165 freezes emissions, resource efficiency, compliance and environmental externalities. Environmental capital spending or remediation may use assets, but externality state does not identify an issuer's complete productive-asset register, project budget, construction rollforward, utilization, maintenance or replacement lifecycle.
repository_evidence.operating_milestone_boundary: Campaign167 freezes discrete commissioning, product approval and patent or R&D milestones. A commissioning announcement is not a complete capital commitment, project budget, construction-in-progress, capitalization, utilization or maintenance history and cannot stand in for one.
repository_evidence.scale_adoption_boundary: Campaign168 freezes output, capacity, store, user and other operating-scale KPIs. Reported scale or adoption does not establish asset ownership, project cash commitment, ready-for-use accounting, physical utilization denominator, idle status or maintenance schedule.
repository_evidence.lease_boundary: Campaign175 freezes right-of-use assets, lease liabilities, payment terms and renewal or termination options. Owned land, buildings, machinery and construction projects require title, project, site, capitalization and physical-use identities that cannot be inferred from rent, lease expense or right-of-use balances.
repository_evidence.enterprise_ma_boundary: Campaign177 freezes transaction lifecycle, control transfer, consideration, purchase-price allocation, earnouts and integration. Ordinary internally developed capital projects and continuing owned-asset utilization do not require a counterparty or control transfer; acquired-asset outcomes cannot substitute for the general asset lifecycle.
repository_evidence.debt_financing_boundary: Campaign161 freezes debt maturity evidence. Borrowing can finance capital expenditure, but debt tenor and repayment do not identify use of proceeds, project approval, construction progress, asset readiness, utilization, maintenance or retirement.
repository_evidence.accounting_and_market_boundary: Standalone fixed assets, construction in progress, depreciation, impairment, capital-expenditure cash flow, total-asset growth or security-price paths are accounting or market outcomes unless bound to stable project, site, asset-class, ownership, stage, revision and first-public histories.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current fixed-asset or construction note cannot be projected backward without project inception, budget approval, change order, expenditure, construction stage, ready-for-use, capitalization, utilization, maintenance, impairment, disposal, decommissioning, correction and first-public histories.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact issuer filing, exchange announcement, regulator record, board-approved capital plan or licensed structured source with immutable document bytes and stable filing, project, site and asset observation identifiers

first-public timestamp, trading-session availability, measurement date, approval, commitment, amendment, suspension, restart, completion, ready-for-use, capitalization, correction and supersession timeline
issuer, listed security, parent, subsidiary, branch, joint operation, project company, site, project, asset class, asset component and ownership mapping without current-state leakage
asset taxonomy separating owned land, building, machinery, transport, electronic, infrastructure, bearer, investment property, right-of-use, intangible, inventory, financial and held-for-sale assets

capital plan, approved budget, contracted commitment, purchase order, cumulative spend, cash paid, unpaid balance, forecast-to-complete, overrun, currency, tax and financing-versus-use-of-funds semantics

project phase covering feasibility, approval, design, permitting, procurement, construction, installation, testing, commissioning, ready-for-use, capitalization, expansion, suspension, abandonment and final acceptance
design, nameplate, available and effective capacity; actual output, utilization denominator, planned and unplanned downtime, idle, mothballed, constrained and temporarily suspended state semantics
asset acquisition date, age, useful life, residual value, depreciation method, componentization, revaluation, impairment unit, recoverable amount, reversal and accounting-policy transition identity
maintenance, inspection, turnaround, overhaul, repair, replacement, modernization, shutdown, restart, decommissioning, restoration obligation and retirement schedule identity
legal title, beneficial ownership, encumbrance, collateral, restricted use, insurance, damage, expropriation, disposal, transfer, sale-and-leaseback and held-for-sale semantics

consolidation scope, gross-versus-net presentation, physical versus monetary unit, currency translation, restatement and missing, undisclosed, not-applicable, true zero commitment, zero spend, zero utilization and fully depreciated semantics

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, issuer, project, site and asset identifier history, delisting coverage, pagination and parser, identity, timing, unit, rollforward and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: approved_capital_expenditure_commitment_and_project_pipeline_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer capital-project state linking approval, budget, contractual commitment, cumulative expenditure, remaining cash obligation and forecast-to-complete to a historically identified project and site.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted point-in-time history freezes project and site identity, approval and amendment chain, budget and commitment semantics, cumulative spend, remaining obligation, currency, consolidation scope, corrections and trading-session availability across the full 2019-2023 issuer universe.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: construction_in_progress_ready_for_use_and_capitalization_transition_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer transition from project construction and testing through ready-for-use, capitalization, final acceptance, suspension, restart or abandonment.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete project-level lineage connecting construction-in-progress additions and transfers to physical stage, ready-for-use criteria, component assets, interest capitalization, partial commissioning, suspension, abandonment, revision and first-public history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: owned_productive_capacity_utilization_idle_and_operating_constraint_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer owned-asset use state connecting design or available capacity, actual output, utilization, planned downtime, idle or mothballed assets and physical operating constraints.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source preserves stable asset and site identity, design-versus-effective capacity, product mix, denominator, maintenance downtime, temporary constraint, outsourcing, seasonality, unit conversion, revisions and complete historical public timing.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: owned_asset_maintenance_overhaul_replacement_and_decommissioning_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer asset-lifecycle state linking planned maintenance, inspection, turnaround, overhaul, replacement, modernization, shutdown, restart, decommissioning and restoration obligations.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time source distinguishes planned maintenance from incidents, maps actions and cash obligations to owned components and sites, and preserves schedule changes, completion, asset age, useful life, replacement, retirement, restoration and public availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: fixed_asset_cip_depreciation_impairment_capex_cash_flow_asset_growth_lease_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing accounting, cash-flow, scale, lease, financing, transaction or security-price state relabeled as productive-asset investment quality or utilization.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Standalone fixed assets, construction in progress, depreciation, impairment, cash-flow capex, asset growth, rent, debt, acquisition consideration or security-price paths do not identify stable projects, owned components, physical readiness, utilization, maintenance or retirement; renaming them would not create a new primitive.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: capex_intensity_project_stage_asset_age_utilization_direction_denominator_window_or_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A direction, transform or subset of capital commitments, project progress, asset age, utilization, downtime, maintenance, replacement or retirement against assets, revenue, cash flow, output, peers or time.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing higher or lower capex, commitment, project stage, utilization or maintenance; gross versus net; denominator; project or asset subset; peer residual; threshold; lag; or event window before base source admission would multiply hypotheses and favor visible successful projects.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_capital_commitment_project_execution_utilization_and_asset_renewal_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint issuer productive-asset score across capital commitments, construction execution, physical utilization, maintenance and replacement or decommissioning.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or choosing ranks, weights, interactions, filters, subsets or models would expand the search before any component has a complete point-in-time source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct productive-asset lifecycle states remain deferred at source admission; accounting, cash-flow, scale, lease, financing, transaction or security-price relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.

next_action: Record all seven scientific decisions in the Campaign178 hash chain, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain.
